identity.title: Dust populations from 30 to 1000 au in the debris disk of HD 120326: Panchromatic view with VLT/SPHERE, ALMA, and HST/STIS

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present new VLT/SPHERE (1.0–1.8 $\mu$m) and ALMA (1.3 mm) data of the debris disk around HD 120326.

evidence.quote: the system HD 120326 (HIP 67497), located at $113.3\pm0.4~\ensuremath{\mathrm{pc}}$ (cite: gaiacollaboration_gaia_2021)

question.value: What are the morphology and dust properties of the HD 120326 debris disk from 30 to 1000 au, combining SPHERE, ALMA and HST/STIS?

evidence.quote: By combining them with archival HST/STIS ($0.2$–$1.0~\ensuremath{\mathrm{\mu m}}$) and archival SPHERE data, we have been able to examine the morphology and photometry of the debris disk, along with its dust properties.
ALMA observations of HD 120326 were acquired as part of project 2022.1.00968.S (PI J. Miley).
The observations use a spectral set-up using Band 6 receivers
